dedupe_keys.name: homogws se a century long homogenized dataset of near surface wind speed observations since 1925 rescued in sweden

description: Chunlüe Zhou and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The dataset provides homogenized monthly near-surface winds at thirteen Swedish stations from 1925 onward. The source describes a ten-member ensemble and explicitly connects the records to assessing long-term wind-energy potential. Individual station text files are visible in the native inventory. The collection is climate input for electricity studies, not turbine SCADA. Homogenization and ensemble uncertainty must be retained when evaluating trends; the source does not imply identical record length or instrumentation at every station. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
